video_title: Jay Pharoah on Voice Acting, Comedy Influences, & Pitching Kawhi Leonard to the Knicks

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green asks Jay Pharoah about his history of kicking players
quotes.excerpt: Why do you kick so many people in their testicles, man? What is up with that?
quotes.quote: Draymond, why do you kick so many people in their testicles, man? What is up with that? Do you not like them? Do you feel like you have to get them?

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Pharoah
text_blocks.text: Draymond, why do you kick so many people in their testicles, man? What is up with that? Do you not like them? Do you feel like you have to get them?

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: So I have a question for you. I have a question for you. How many people have I kicked there?

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green addresses the Stephen Adams kick incident
quotes.excerpt: I kicked someone there once, which was Stephen Adams. I definitely did not try to get him.
quotes.quote: I kicked someone there once, which was Stephen Adams. I definitely did not try to get him there, but I did. Then in that same series, I went up for a layup and he is on top of me and he hit me with the knee. But in basketball, I do not know how much basketball you can play, Jay, but I will explain a layup to you. When you jump and you go up for a layup with the right hand, the right knee goes up. If you are above me, that is your fault. You are in the personal space. That is a natural layup, and so they said, oh man, he got him again. No, that actually is not even the same motion.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the 2019 Knicks recruitment of Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Apparently in 2019, the Knicks were recruiting Kawhi Leonard. There was an SNL style celebrity video.
quotes.quote: Apparently in 2019, the Knicks were recruiting Kawhi Leonard. There was an SNL style celebrity video that you were actually in, playing Kawhi. This is what I heard. I have not seen the video, so I do not know. Number one, is it true? And if it is true, how in the hell did this thing come together?

quotes.speaker: Jay Pharoah
quotes.summary_phrase: Jay Pharoah confirms his role in the 2019 Knicks recruitment video
quotes.excerpt: It is absolutely true. The Knicks were trying to acquire him. They recruited me and Keenan Thompson.
quotes.quote: It is absolutely true. The Knicks were trying to acquire him. They recruited me and also Keenan Thompson. I think Keenan was my manager in it. But yeah, I played Kawhi Leonard. I had the Harriet Tubman braids and everything, bro. I had to. I love Kawhi Leonard, but it is still something. When they freshly done, they do not look freshly done. They do not. And it is him and who is it? Shout out to both of them because Kawhi Leonard is a beast as you know. He is one of the best. He is crazy, but he has got the Jim Jones braids. Jim Jones is the same way, bro. You see, boom, and then the braids be fuzzy. Why are they fuzzy? Did you roll around? I do not know if you used to have braids. I did when I was a kid.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the Clippers' trade investigation
quotes.excerpt: In 2019, when you did that video, Kawhi was actually leaving Toronto and went to the Clippers.
quotes.quote: In 2019, when you did that video, Kawhi was actually leaving Toronto and went to the Clippers. He was looking to make a free agent decision, and he went to the Clippers. He is headed back to Toronto now, apparently, here we are seven years later, apparently. Except there are some allegations out there that have put the trade on hold. I do not know if you have heard about those allegations or not, have you?

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the Clippers' cap circumvention investigation
quotes.excerpt: There are some allegations that he and the Clippers circumvented the cap and he is being investigated.
quotes.quote: There are some allegations that he and the Clippers circumvented the cap and he is being investigated by the NBA. The Clippers are all being investigated and the trade right now is on hold. But we will see, but I just thought that was a full circle moment, be that you were recruiting him to the Knicks in 2019. 2026, the Knicks win a championship, Kawhi is going back the way he left, and you know, he should have went to the Knicks.
